name: app-decoding-time-by-time
summary: Decodes condition labels over time from MEG gradiometer epochs with MNE-Python SlidingEstimator (standardised logistic regression, 5-fold ROC AUC) and plots the decoding score time course.
description: Selects the 'auditory' epochs, keeps the gradiometer channels and fits a scikit-learn pipeline (StandardScaler and LogisticRegression) independently at each time point with mne.decoding.SlidingEstimator, scoring with 5-fold cross-validated ROC AUC against event codes. Outputs a PNG of the mean score over time with the chance level. The condition name and channel type are hard-coded (MNE sample-dataset style 'auditory' left vs right), so it only runs on epochs that contain an 'auditory' condition with two event codes and gradiometers.

inputs.requirements: Must contain gradiometer channels and events tagged auditory with two classes.

outputs.description: Sensor-Space-Decoding.png: mean cross-validated ROC AUC over time with the chance level.
